title: Workout photos in the Profile feed are drawn from the full-size camera pictures
what: Workout photos are kept at the camera's full size (only lightly compressed, never made smaller). Each card in the Profile workouts feed shows up to four of them as small squares, and the workout page shows them too, each time opening the full-size picture. Scrolling a feed with many photo workouts on a cheap phone has to decode several large pictures per card, which can make the scroll stutter. Not measured on a phone.
expected: Each photo is saved with a small preview copy, and the feed and the workout page show the preview; the full picture opens only when the member taps to view it full screen.
how_often: every time the feed is scrolled
fix_line: Save a small preview of each workout photo and show that in the feed and on the workout page

items.reason: these are phone app parts of the workout tracker; no panel web pages here (pagespeed.json covers the panel and websites)
no file in this area talks to the online database; reads are the phone's own store and saved lists
